prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t one objectively “best” lawyer for every Houston car-wreck case. The best lawyer for you depends on the severity of your injuries, whether the case might go to trial, your location, language needs, and other personal preferences. I can help you find the best fit.

How to find the best personal-injury lawyer for a Houston car wreck
- Experience with car-accident cases and trial experience (look for significant auto-injury work and willingness to go to trial).  
- Board certification: Texas Board of Legal Specialization offers Personal Injury Trial Law certification — that’s a meaningful credential.  
- Track record: sizable settlements/verdicts in similar cases (catastrophic injury, wrongful death, etc.).  
- Fee structure: most work on contingency (typical 33–40% of recovery) — confirm costs/expenses and what happens if you lose.  
- Communication and staffing: who actually handles your case (attorney vs. paralegal) and how often you’ll get updates.  
- Client reviews and peer ratings (Google, Martindale-Hubbell, AVVO/history, Better Business Bureau).  
- Local presence and familiarity with Houston courts, judges, and insurance adjusters.  
- No unresolved disciplinary actions with the State Bar of Texas.

What to do next (practical steps)
1. Narrow to 3–5 firms/attorneys and schedule free consultations.  
2. Ask during the consult: how many car wreck cases in last 3–5 years, sample outcomes, who will handle my file, contingency fee percentage, anticipated timeline, whether they advance costs, and if they’ll take the case to trial if needed.  
3. Check the State Bar of Texas for disciplinary records and the Texas Board of Legal Specialization for certifications.  
4. Pick the lawyer you feel most comfortable communicating with and who has demonstrable results in similar cases.

If you want, I can:
- Provide a short list of highly rated Houston car-accident lawyers/firms tailored to your ZIP code and case details, or  
- Draft a list of questions to ask at your free consultations.

Tell me your ZIP code and a little about your crash (severity of injuries, at-fault status, whether you’ve been treated, any deadlines like a statute of limitations), and I’ll pull a targeted shortlist.
